character_einar_v1.neural_asset_domain: Torso garment and every human/robot arm surface that can participate in the selected arm-to-torso approach; no head, legs, footwear, hair, satchel, scene props, or rig widgets.
included_surface_rules: GEO-thumb*, GEO-index*, GEO-middle*, GEO-pinkie*, GEO-palm*, GEO-plate*, GEO-cushion*, GEO-fasteners*
excluded_surface_rules: head, face, teeth, tongue, hat, hair and curve/groom objects
pants, boots, knee hardware and all lower-body surfaces
satchel, dart, unrelated props, cameras, lights, helper meshes and rig widgets
character_einar_v1.rationale: The included domain contains both sides of the future mutual-visibility interaction and the garment immediately around the torso. Exclusions cannot cast or receive the selected arm-torso transport under the fixed close camera and would expand the learned volume without supporting the target claim.

cloth_rain_v2_garment_set.neural_asset_domain: GEO-rain_scarf plus GEO-rain_top as one interacting garment transport domain.
excluded_surface_rules: Rain body, head, hair, eyes, jeans, shoes, rig widgets and scene helpers
cloth_rain_v2_garment_set.rationale: The intended secondary case includes scarf fold/cavity formation and scarf-to-top proximity. Training scarf alone would remove a physically relevant receiver/occluder and make later scarf-top transport inconsistent.
